messages:
Sam L.: Heads-up — we're hitting a hard limit in europe-west1 and need a short-term burst of A100 capacity for a customer demo tomorrow. Opened a case but wanted to loop everyone: case# GCP-2026-99877.
Ellie P.: thanks Sam. do we know which project needs the burst? can we move the workloads to another project with spare quota? :thinking_face:
Sam L.: original workloads are in project redwood-prod-eu, but billing + security requires using the new reserved project redwood-dedicated-eu for this customer. need quota in that project too. planning a project-swap + quota increase.
Rafa G.: what exact quotas are we requesting? GPUs by type and any IP/subnet limits?
Sam L.: requesting: 10 x A100-80GB (nvidia-a100), + increase for regional INTERNAL_IPS (secondary ranges) in subnet 'inference-pool-eu' from 250 -> 1000. Also need 100 ephemeral external IPs for job debugging window.
Oncall SRE: FYI, network team reported secondary range exhaustion yesterday for that VPC. if we bump IPs we should confirm subnet sizing and whether we can use alias IPs on the worker nodes.
Matt R.: tagging config snippet I used to inspect quotas:
```
# check region quotas
gcloud compute regions describe europe-west1 --project=redwood-dedicated-eu --format=json | jq '.quotas[] | {metric: .metric, limit: .limit, usage: .usage}'
```
Matt R.: Also opened an internal billing handshake with account team to link redwood-dedicated-eu to our enterprise billing account — GCP sometimes blocks quota increases on unlinked projects.
GCP Support: Automated update: case GCP-2026-99877 assigned to engineer Nisha K. Please respond with the project number, VPC name, and iAM contact. ETA 4-6 business hours for initial review.
Sam L.: project number: 1029384756. VPC: prod-vpc-inference-eu. IAM contact: ellie.p@redwood.ai. Adding screenshot of quota page.
Ellie P.: added billing owner @matt and security owner @rafa. Matt — can you confirm the billing linkage?
Matt R.: confirmed billing link from our side. Message sent to GCP account team to expedite. :thumbsup:
GCP Support: Nisha K.: quick question — do the A100s need to be in a single zone or spread across zones? Also please confirm whether preemptible instances are acceptable for the demo workload.
Sam L.: need them in a single zone (europe-west1-b) to ensure NVLink topology. preemptible not acceptable for this run.
Rafa G.: alternative: if GCP can't fulfill, can we fall back to us-west2 on AWS spot p4d? that'll add latency but might be a viable fallback.
Ellie P.: fallback is last resort — customer demo uses eu region compliance. try to escalate with GCP first.
Oncall SRE: noted. I'm starting a transient autoscaler policy change to keep existing node pools from scaling down overnight so we don't lose in-use internal IPs.
GCP Support: Nisha K.: escalated to quota team. Case update: requested quota spreadsheet submitted; account team confirmed enterprise contract. Anticipate approval within 12-24 hours. Will notify when applied.
Sam L.: thanks — can you also include the subnet secondary range increase request in the same case? that was missed in the initial form.
GCP Support: Nisha K.: added subnet secondary range request to case. One more ask: please provide a handful of example instance names + startup scripts that will be used (for security review).
Sam L.: example instance names: inference-demo-001..010. startup script: uses our internal launch wrapper and pulls image redwood/inference:prod-2026-03. snippet:
```
#!/bin/bash
/opt/redwood/bin/launch-worker --model a100-80gb --cache-size 100GB
```
Sam L.: pinging @account-team for escalation if we don't see quota applied by 09:00 UTC tomorrow.
Matt R.: noted. I'm also prepping a quick runbook to re-route traffic to a dedicated fallback cluster in frankfurt if needed.
GCP Support: Automated update: quota team has queued the request. Next update expected within 6-12 hours. Case GCP-2026-99877.
Ellie P.: thanks all. keep this thread for status updates only — let's avoid duplicating messages across channels. :eyes:
Rafa G.: if we get approval, Sam/Matt — can you also coordinate an immediate smoke test plan? small batch of requests to validate latency and NVLink behavior.
Sam L.: yes — plan: 5 warmup runs, then 3 timed inference batches. will post results here.
GCP Support: Final update: Quotas increased. A100 quota increased to 12 in europe-west1, internal IP quota updated, and subnet secondary range expanded. Changes applied at 1748001400. Please verify and close the case if all good.
Oncall SRE: confirmed nodes launched and registered in k8s, 10 A100s visible to the scheduler. smoke tests queued.
Sam L.: smoke tests passed — latency within SLO and NVLink appears stable. closing loop with customer. closing case locally. :tada:
Ellie P.: awesome work team, great coordination.
Rafa G.: nice, well done everyone.
